Foreigner Purchase Guidance
外籍人士置业指南

Buying Property in Malaysia
as a Foreigner — What You Need to Know

外籍人士在马来西亚
置业须知

Malaysia is one of the few countries in Southeast Asia where foreigners can own freehold property. However, each state sets its own minimum purchase price and consent requirements. Here's exactly what you need to know before you invest.

马来西亚是东南亚少数允许外籍人士拥有永久地契房产的国家之一。然而，每个州对最低购买价格和审批要求均有所不同。以下是您投资前需要了解的重要信息。

Minimum Purchase Price by State (2025–2026) 各州外籍人士最低购买价格（2025–2026）
State州属 High-Rise / Strata高层 / 分层地契 Landed Property有地房产 Notes备注
Kuala Lumpur (WP) RM 1,000,000 RM 1,000,000 No state consent fee. Most popular for condos in KLCC, Mont Kiara, Bangsar. 无州审批费。KLCC、Mont Kiara、Bangsar 公寓最受欢迎。
Selangor RM 1,500,000 – RM 2,000,000 (Zones 1–2) Largely restricted (landed strata/gated only) 限制较多（仅限有地分层/围闭式） Higher threshold than KL. Foreigners limited to strata title only in most zones. RM 1M applies in Zone 3 (outer districts). 门槛高于吉隆坡。大多数地区外籍人士仅限购买分层地契。第三区（外围地区）为 RM 100万。
Penang RM 1,000,000 (island)
RM 500,000 (mainland) 		RM 3,000,000 (island)
RM 750,000–1,800,000 (mainland) 		Additional 3% state levy on island purchases. Overhang units may have lower thresholds. State consent required for properties below RM 3M. 槟岛购房额外征收 3% 州税。滞销单位可能享有较低门槛。低于 RM 300万的房产需州审批。
Johor Bahru RM 1,000,000 RM 2,000,000 (international zones) Special exemptions in Medini Iskandar & JS-SEZ. Proximity to Singapore drives strong demand. R&F Princess Cove has state-approved exceptions below RM 1M. 美迪尼伊斯干达及 JS-SEZ 享有特别豁免。毗邻新加坡带动强劲需求。碧桂园 · 翡翠湾享有低于 RM 100万的州批准豁免。
Melaka RM 500,000 RM 1,000,000 One of the most accessible states for foreigners. Affordable lifestyle, UNESCO heritage city, growing tourism economy. 外籍人士置业门槛最低的州属之一。生活实惠，联合国教科文组织遗产城市，旅游经济蓬勃。

* Thresholds are indicative and subject to state policy updates. Always verify with a licensed lawyer before signing. Overhang unit exemptions may apply. * 门槛仅供参考，以各州最新政策为准。签署前请向持牌律师核实。滞销单位豁免条例可能适用。

📋
State Authority Consent 州政府审批

Every foreign purchase requires written consent from the State Land Authority (Section 433B, National Land Code). This applies regardless of property type or price. Processing typically takes 2–4 months. 所有外籍人士购房均须取得州土地局书面批准（国家土地法典第 433B 条）。无论房产类型或价格，此规定均适用。处理时间通常为 2–4 个月。

🏦
Financing for Foreigners 外籍人士贷款

Malaysian banks offer financing to foreign buyers at 60–70% loan margin (up to 80% for MM2H holders). Income proof from your home country is required. Engage a bank-approved valuer for property assessment. 马来西亚银行为外籍买家提供 60–70% 贷款（MM2H 持有人可达 80%）。需提供母国收入证明，并委托银行认可的估价师评估房产。

💰
Stamp Duty & RPGT 印花税与产业盈利税

From Jan 2026: flat 4% stamp duty on property transfers by non-citizens. Real Property Gains Tax (RPGT) at 30% if sold within 5 years, reducing to 10% after 5 years. Budget 5–7% total on-costs. 自 2026 年 1 月起：非公民过户印花税统一为 4%。产业盈利税（RPGT）：5 年内出售征 30%，5 年后降至 10%。预算总附加费用约 5–7%。

🏠
What Foreigners Can Buy 外籍人士可购买的房产类型

✅ Condos & Serviced Suites (most common) ✅ Freehold & Leasehold ✅ Landed (state-dependent) ❌ Malay Reserve Land ❌ Bumiputera lots ❌ Affordable/Low-cost housing ✅ 公寓与服务式公寓（最普遍） ✅ 永久及租赁地契 ✅ 有地房产（视州属而定） ❌ 马来保留地 ❌ 土著特定单位 ❌ 可负担/廉价房屋

📊
Rental Yields 租金回报

Malaysia offers 3–6% gross rental yields in key urban and resort markets. KLCC corridor and Mont Kiara typically yield 4–5%. Rental income from residential property is permitted for foreigners. 马来西亚主要城市及度假市场毛租金回报约 3–6%。KLCC 走廊及 Mont Kiara 通常约 4–5%。外籍人士可从住宅房产获取租金收入。

⚖️
Legal Process (Step-by-Step) 置业法律流程

1. Booking & Letter of Offer → 2. SPA signing (within 21–30 days) → 3. Apply for State Consent → 4. Bank loan processing → 5. Title transfer & registration. Total timeline: 4–8 months. 1. 预订及意向书 → 2. 签署买卖协议（21–30 天内）→ 3. 申请州政府批准 → 4. 银行贷款处理 → 5. 产权转让登记。全程约 4–8 个月。

MM2H Programme

Malaysia My Second Home
Long-Stay Visa — Your Complete Guide

马来西亚第二家园计划
长期居留签证完整指南

The Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) programme is a government-backed long-stay visa allowing foreigners to reside in Malaysia for up to 20 years. Revamped in 2024 with a new four-tier structure, it remains one of Asia's most attractive long-term residency options.

马来西亚第二家园（MM2H）是政府支持的长期居留签证计划，允许外籍人士在马来西亚居住最长 20 年。该计划于 2024 年进行重大改革，推出全新四级制度，依然是亚洲最具吸引力的长期居留选择之一。

Key Benefits主要福利
✓ Multiple-entry long-stay visa (5–20 years renewable) 多次入境长期居留签证（5–20 年可续签）
✓ Own freehold or leasehold residential property 拥有永久或租赁地契住宅房产
✓ Foreign income is tax-exempt in Malaysia — no need to file 海外收入在马来西亚免税，无需申报
✓ Include spouse, children (up to 34, unmarried), parents & parents-in-law 可携带配偶、子女（34岁以下未婚）、父母及岳父母
✓ Withdraw up to 50% of fixed deposit for property, healthcare or education 可提取最多 50% 定期存款用于房产、医疗或教育
✓ Minimum stay: 90 cumulative days per year (principal or dependants) 最低居留要求：每年累计 90 天（申请人或家属）
Application Requirements申请要求
01 Valid passport (min. 18 months remaining validity) 有效护照（至少剩余 18 个月有效期）
02 Bank statements proving sufficient liquid assets (matching tier) 证明充足流动资产的银行对账单（符合相应级别）
03 Police clearance certificate from home country 母国无犯罪记录证明
04 Medical check-up in Malaysia + valid Malaysian health insurance 在马来西亚进行体检 + 有效的马来西亚医疗保险
05 Must apply through a MOTAC-licensed MM2H agent (no direct applications) 须通过 MOTAC 持牌 MM2H 代理申请（不接受直接申请）
06 Property purchase must be completed within 12 months of visa endorsement and held for 10 years 须在签证批准后 12 个月内完成房产购买，并持有 10 年
⏱ Processing Time: ⏱ 处理时间： Typically 3–6 months after full document submission. Applications must be submitted via a licensed agent. 完整文件提交后通常需 3–6 个月。申请须通过持牌代理提交。
